synthetic_continual_low_rank.description: Scaled continual low-rank classification benchmark for the Share core claim; paper reference shape is Table 1 GLUE performance/parameter tradeoff.

final_average_accuracy.description: Mean final classification accuracy across all tasks in the stream.

average_forgetting.description: Average drop from each task's best historical accuracy to its final accuracy.

trainable_parameters.description: Reported final trainable or stored task-adaptation parameter count.

temporary_adaptation_parameters.description: Reported peak temporary adaptation parameter count used while learning a new task.

parameter_fraction_vs_lora_stream.description: Final adaptation parameters divided by the independent-LoRA stream parameter count.

temporary_parameter_fraction_vs_lora_str.description: Peak temporary adaptation parameters divided by the independent-LoRA stream parameter count.

compression_ratio_vs_lora_stream.description: Independent-LoRA stream parameter count divided by the final adaptation parameter count.

task_0_accuracy.description: Final accuracy on the first task, catching early-task forgetting.
